description: Look up a podcast show on OP3 and get its UUID, title, podcast GUID, and stats page URL. Pass a show UUID, a podcast:guid, or a base64-encoded feed URL. This is the entry point: most other tools need the show UUID this returns. Set include_episodes to also list episodes (id, title, pubdate).

episode_limit.description: Max episodes to return when include_episodes is true (default 10).

identifier.description: Show identifier: an OP3 show UUID (32 hex chars), a podcast:guid, or a base64-encoded feed URL. Use op3_get_show to resolve a feed to its UUID.

include_episodes.description: Include the episode list. Off by default to keep the response small.

name: op3_get_show
